items.description: Beat Hand of the King / Queen / Dracula Final Form with 0 BSC active

items.name: BSC 2
items.description: Beat final boss with 1 BSC active

items.name: BSC 3
items.description: Beat final boss with 2 BSC active

items.description: Beat final boss with 3 BSC active

tags: Unlocks the True Final Boss and true ending.

items.name: Vine Rune
items.description: Grow climbing vines from green blobs. Unlocks Toxic Sewers access.

items.name: Teleportation Rune
items.description: Use teleportation monoliths throughout the map. Unlocks Ossuary and Forgotten Sepulcher.

items.name: Ram Rune
items.description: Smash through orange-glyphed floors. Unlocks Ancient Sewers and underground sections.

items.name: Spider Rune
items.description: Climb walls. Unlocks Graveyard, Prison Depths, and many shortcuts.

items.name: Challenger's Rune
items.description: Unlocks Daily Challenge mode door in Prisoners' Quarters.

items.name: Explorer's Rune
items.description: Auto-reveals the full map and all points of interest (scrolls, merchants).

items.name: Homunculus Rune
items.description: Detach your head to fly and reach hidden areas. Unlocks Cavern (Rise of the Giant).

items.name: Customization Rune
items.description: Unlocks Custom Mode (Speed Run, One Hit One Kill, outfit options, etc.).

items.name: The Concierge
items.description: Drops Challenger's Rune on first defeat.

items.name: Conjunctivius
items.description: Access via Ancient Sewers.

items.name: Hand of the King
items.description: Drops Homunculus Rune and BSC 1–4 (one per run at the correct difficulty).

items.name: The Giant
items.description: Requires 4 BSC active. Drops BSC 5.

items.name: True Final Boss
items.description: Requires 5 BSC. Spoiler boss — the true ending of the game.

items.name: Mama Tick
items.description: Alternate Boss 1 reached via Dilapidated Arboretum.

items.name: The Scarecrow
items.description: Alternate Boss 2 reached via Fractured Shrines.

items.name: The Servants
items.description: Calliope, Euterpe & Kleio. Fight through the lighthouse. Last Servant defeated drops their weapon.

items.name: The Queen
items.description: Alternate final boss. Drops Queen's Rapier. Counts for BSC acquisition.

items.name: Death
items.description: Alternate Boss 2 on the Castlevania path.

items.name: Dracula — Final Form
items.description: Alternate final boss. Counts for BSC acquisition.

items.name: Prisoners' Quarters
items.description: Starting area for every run. Contains the Aspect vendor and BSC tube.

items.name: Promenade of the Condemned
items.description: Contains Vine Rune.

items.name: Toxic Sewers
items.description: Requires Vine Rune. Contains Teleportation Rune.

items.name: Corrupted Prison
items.description: Requires Teleportation Rune.

items.name: Prison Depths
items.description: Requires Spider Rune.

items.name: Dilapidated Arboretum
items.description: Requires Teleportation Rune. Alternate early path → Nest.

items.name: Black Bridge
items.description: The Concierge.

items.name: Nest
items.description: Mama Tick. Alternate Boss 1 via Arboretum.

items.name: Ossuary
items.description: Requires Teleportation Rune. Contains Ram Rune.

items.name: Ancient Sewers
items.description: Requires Ram Rune.

items.name: Ramparts
items.description: Contains Customization Rune.

items.name: Graveyard
items.description: Requires Spider Rune.

items.name: Morass of the Banished
items.description: Part of Bad Seed path after Nest.

items.name: Fractured Shrines
items.description: Alternate mid-game path.

items.name: Castle's Outskirts
items.description: Access via Richter in Prisoners' Quarters.

items.name: Insufferable Crypt
items.description: Conjunctivius.

items.name: Mausoleum
items.description: The Scarecrow. Alternate Boss 2 via Fractured Shrines.

items.name: Defiled Necropolis
items.description: Death. Alternate Boss 2 on Castlevania path.

items.name: Slumbering Sanctuary
items.description: Contains Spider Rune. Access via Ancient Sewers → Insufferable Crypt.

items.name: Forgotten Sepulcher
items.description: Requires Teleportation Rune. Contains Explorer's Rune.

items.name: Undying Shores
items.description: Part of Fatal Falls path after Scarecrow.

items.name: Infested Shipwreck
items.description: Alternate late-game path via Queen and the Sea DLC.

items.name: Dracula's Castle
items.description: Collect 20 Castlevania outfits here.

items.name: Clock Room
items.description: The Time Keeper.

items.name: Lighthouse
items.description: The Servants — fight up the lighthouse.

items.name: Master's Keep
items.description: Dracula (Boss 3), then Dracula Final Form (Boss 4).

items.name: Cavern
items.description: Requires Homunculus Rune.

items.name: Throne Room
items.description: Hand of the King. Drops Homunculus Rune + BSC 1–4.

items.name: The Crown
items.description: The Queen. Alternate final boss.

items.name: Guardian's Haven
items.description: The Giant — requires 4 BSC. Drops BSC 5.

items.name: True Ending Area
items.description: Requires 5 BSC. True final boss and ending.

items.name: The Bank
items.description: Appears randomly once you've entered a final boss area. Replaces the next biome when a golden chest triggers it.

items.name: White Defender
items.source: Dream Nail the sleeping Dung Defender

categories.description: Bosses added by the free content packs.

items.name: Troupe Master Grimm
items.source: Light the Nightmare Lantern and complete the ritual

items.name: Nightmare King Grimm
items.source: Dream Nail the troupe master after defeating him
items.description: Only available on the "summon the troupe" route — not the "banish" route.

categories.name: Godhome-Exclusive Bosses
categories.description: Boss variants and final encounters found only in Godhome.

items.name: Sisters of Battle
items.description: Full-power rematch with all three Mantis Lords.

items.name: Winged Nosk
items.description: A Godhome-exclusive variant of Nosk's fight.

items.name: Pure Vessel
items.description: The Hollow Knight at its unshackled peak.

items.name: Absolute Radiance
items.description: Final encounter of Pantheon 5. Unlocks the "Embrace the Void" ending.

categories.name: Colosseum of Fools
categories.description: Three trials in the arena at the top of Kingdom's Edge.

items.name: Trial of the Fool
items.description: The hardest trial. Clearing unlocks God Tamer.

categories.name: Pantheons
categories.description: The five boss rushes of Godhome. Each must be cleared without dying.

items.name: Pantheon of the Master
items.description: Boss rush focused on the earliest fights.

items.name: Pantheon of the Artist
items.description: Includes the Sisters of Battle and other mid-game upgrades.

items.name: Pantheon of the Sage
items.description: Deeper challenges including Enraged Guardian and Collector.

items.name: Pantheon of the Knight
items.description: Top-tier fights culminating in Pure Vessel.

items.name: Pantheon of Hallownest
items.description: All 42 bosses back-to-back, ending with Absolute Radiance.

categories.name: Nail Upgrades
categories.description: Upgraded at the Nailsmith with pale ore + geo.

categories.name: Nail Arts
categories.description: Three techniques taught by the Great Nailmasters.

categories.name: Spells
categories.description: Each spell has a base and an upgraded form.

categories.name: Mask Shards
categories.description: 16 shards in total — 4 per extra mask, for a max of 9 masks.

categories.name: Vessel Fragments
categories.description: 9 fragments in total — 3 per extra soul vessel.

categories.name: Charms
categories.description: Equippable charms of Hallownest. Notch costs in metadata — some may need correction.

items.name: Fragile Heart
items.source: Can be upgraded to Unbreakable Heart at Divine (Grimm Troupe)

items.name: Heavy Blow
items.location: City of Tears (Sly, after Shopkeeper's Key)

items.name: Carefree Melody
items.source: Banish the Grimm Troupe via Nightmare Lantern destruction

items.name: Kingsoul → Void Heart
items.description: Assemble from Queen Fragment + King Fragment, then awakens to Void Heart at the Birthplace. Notch cost drops to 0.

categories.name: Pale Ore
categories.description: 6 pieces total — enough to fully upgrade the Nail (with one to spare for Nailsmith quest outcomes).

items.name: Pale Ore #5
items.location: Colosseum of Fools (Trial of the Conqueror reward)

categories.name: Grubs
categories.description: 46 grubs sealed in jars throughout Hallownest. Free them for rewards from the Grubfather.

categories.name: Whispering Roots
categories.description: Dream Nail into each root to release essence. Area counts are approximate from memory.

categories.name: Hallownest Seals
categories.description: Sell to Relic Seeker Lemm, or keep for Dream Nail essence.

categories.name: King's Idols
categories.description: Relics depicting the Pale King. 8 total throughout Hallownest.

categories.name: Arcane Eggs
categories.description: Mysterious eggs worth a fortune to Lemm. Only 4 in the game.

categories.name: Wanderer's Journals
categories.description: The most common relic. 14 scattered across Hallownest.

categories.name: Endings
categories.description: Ending names and descriptions are hidden until you reach them, or hit Reveal.

items.name: The Hollow Knight
items.description: The default ending — defeat The Hollow Knight without Void Heart equipped.

items.name: Sealed Siblings
items.description: Acquire Void Heart, then defeat The Hollow Knight.

items.name: Dream No More
items.description: Acquire Void Heart and the Awoken Dream Nail, enter the dream, defeat The Radiance.

items.name: Embrace the Void
items.description: Complete Pantheon of Hallownest in Godhome — defeat Absolute Radiance.

structuredData.completionNotes: 112% completion requires all charms including the Grimm Troupe route-exclusive pair, plus the Godmaster pantheons. Source content: base game + Hidden Dreams + The Grimm Troupe + Lifeblood + Godmaster (all included in the Switch 2 Edition).
